quest.title: Make Bright the Arrows, Gather the Shields...
quest.description: Jeht has not yet returned to the tribe, and now you can only count on the results of Babel's investigation...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: Her Foes Rage Like Great Waters...

talks.objective: Wait till the next day and talk to Babel again

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Esteemed Master of the Jinni! There is an urgent matter that I need to inform you of!

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: I was so shocked when I first heard about it... Oh, where should I begin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Jeht... Jeht, she's... I hate to say it, but she... could very well be a traitor to the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any proof?

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Some time earlier, we caught a northerner who knew Jeht. He told us... that Jeht had revealed to them the location of all our outposts.

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: If all our outposts are exposed, the actions of the entire Tanit tribe in the desert will be utterly restrained...

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: What's more, according to him, Jeht has already sent out several batches of assassins, her very target being you... who possesses the Jinni.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Isn't that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: If his confession's true, Jeht should be active in their camp.

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: And according to our recent reports, the northerners are indeed closing in on our tribe. They have bypassed our sentries and set up camps at a dangerously close distance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Those are signs, not proof.

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: In the desert, no one should take any ominous sign lightly. The excessive speculation of "Jeht is a traitor" is just the worst inference I have made based on the existing signs...

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Plus... She hasn't been back for a long time. I'm really worried about her.

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Please forgive me for making such a speculation... But I genuinely think of her as my own daughter. No matter what she might've become, it is the consequence of my own mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Therefore, esteemed Master of the Jinni, I beg you, regardless of the path she has chosen, bring her back to me...

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Whether she lives to prove her innocence, or has paid for her missteps.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... did Jeht really betray us?

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: I'll mark the location of the northerners' forward operating base on your map. Just keep looking in this direction and you won't miss it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will find her, figure everything out, and bring her back.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Sorry, it all happened so suddenly... It's hard even for me to accept such a twist.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Please bring her back to me and let me talk to her, will you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry. We will!

choices.text: Tell me where she might be.

talks.objective: Go to the place Babel mentioned
Proceed to the place Babel mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Yuften
dialogues.text: H—H—Hello, e—e—esteemed Master of the Jinni!

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: N—Not too bad. It was quite a shame that we lost Aderfi, a—along with all those goods. Fortunately, we still have contact with o—other merchants, so the l—loss is s—still acceptable.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Th—The supply of seeds, soil, and Anahitian Blessing is fairly normal, b—but some annoying bandits s—s—still show up every now and then and rob our caravans. D—Darn it!

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Traitors, and Jeht... Ugh! Must be those northerners behind all this!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About the northerners...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Th—They came into the desert a long time ago. Th—They'd trade things with us, teach us new te—te—techniques.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: At that time, w—we thought they were good people, much warmer than those city people who live in trees...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: But then, th—they started using those advanced, shiny things to lure our people, make them b—break away from the tribe, and m—make them rebels.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Th—That's when we discovered that these northerners a—are not good people, b—but enemies that should be guarded against.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: F—First it was Aderfi and Azariq, now even Jeht...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: *sigh* Sometimes, I—I—I don't even know who to trust.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: I—I—I'm sorry... I never thought sh—sh—she would become a traitor.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Matriarch Babel trusted her so much. I—I—I adored her as well. She was like a l—little an—antelope, hehe... But that northerner said, he said...

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Sh—She may be coming for you. If you are to investigate the matter, please d—do be careful!

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: Th—The assault last time... Sh—She must've been the one who's behind it.

response.speaker: Yuften
response.text: *sigh* H—How, how could this happen...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... "Gerardo," "Ice Cream," "Pierogi"... They have mixed passwords from different times! Which one's the real password?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guess we have to try them one by one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... Paimon has no better idea.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And it looks like they've moved the location of their main camp! Hmm... This map looks way too ugly! Paimon can only roughly make out the direction they went...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, let's catch up in the direction they left, shall we?

talks.objective: Look for clues as to Jeht's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Empty Wooden Box
dialogues.text: (An empty wooden box, which has not been buried by the sands yet. Obviously, it was just recently abandoned, and the owner should not have gone far.)

dialogues.speaker: Large Military Boots
dialogues.text: (Apparently, these are military assets belonging to the Fatui Skirmishers. It is unclear how they ended up here. They're already filled with sand...)

dialogues.speaker: Large Military Boots
dialogues.text: (Wearing these now must be extra tormenting...)

dialogues.speaker: Scattered Matchsticks
dialogues.text: (An opened matchbox with the Fatui's Delusion logo printed on it. Used matchsticks are scattered around it, not yet buried by the sands.)

dialogues.speaker: Scattered Matchsticks
dialogues.text: (One cannot help but wonder why the Fatui Skirmishers would use this method to start a fire when they could simply drive elements.)

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
dialogues.text: Who are you? Password!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Password! What was the one that we found again?

response.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
response.text: Huh? "Gerardo"? What is that? Sounds like some air freshener brand.

response.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
response.text: Hey, Ilyusha, "Gerardo"! Does that ring a bell? I've never heard of it.

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: "Gerardo"? Nah. Is that the brand of the baby powder you use?

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Do I look like someone who uses off-brand baby powder? The Mr. Charming Yevgraf, using "Gerardo"!? Am I a joke to you?

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: C'mon, I was just asking! Why are you so worked up!?

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: How dare you humiliate me and ask me to calm down? Am I someone with such bad taste? Do I look like someone who uses "Gerardo"?

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: *sigh* Alright, sorry! I apologize, come on! Stop fighting over some baby powder! Anyway, what did you just ask...?

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: Hold on a sec... Yes, you asked about the password! Ah, I do have a vague impression. Lemme check the password list real quick...

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Hmph, this is the attitude that my colleague should have!

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Hey, you there! Do I look like someone who uses "Gerardo"?

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: See, I told you! I only use Fontaine brands. And listen, if you are looking to buy any skin care or hair products, my advice is all you're gonna need.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Don't get yourself fooled by that stupid "Gerardo."

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: Hey, hey, Yevgrash, I found it! The password "Gerardo" was selected by Kapitan Zoya. It's... uh... her favorite puppy.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Oh! Oh... I—I see.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: I—I've never used "Gerardo," actually.

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: I know, I'll keep it a secret.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Thanks, man.

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: But... Well... This password has expired, now that we just changed it. Now it's... Well, it's a little embarrassing, haha. It's that... little... thing.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: What? Kapitan Zoya's cat?

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: Pfft... Ahem! N—No. It's another cute little animal. As soft and furry as a cat, but smaller and more docile...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I guess it's bigger than a mouse, but smaller than a ferret.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what are you doing!? This isn't the time for riddles! We still have business to do!

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: That's right! And we, too, have serious work on our hands! Sorry, that was the correct password, but unfortunately, it's no longer valid.

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: Ding ding ding! You're out! Both of you!

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: Then what was Kapitan Zoya's order again? Ah, that's right... Those who fail to match the password shall be executed on the spot.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: So, uh, sorry, friend. I can't let others know that I've used "Gerardo."

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: Yeah, we're really sorry... Wait... What do you mean you've used it!?

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Shut up and fire!

response.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
response.text: Uh... Nope.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Um... "Pierogi"?

response.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
response.text: Nice try. What next? "Cheese"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh*

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Never mind. Let's just fight.

response.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
response.text: Uh... Thanks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, you've actually got manners!

talks.objective: Investigate the figure in the sandstorm

choices.text: Look, I just found a boot of yours.

response.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher
response.text: Huh? Oh, I see... Uh, thanks? Ilyusha? Ilyusha!

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: Yes, Yevgrash! I heard you!

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: What's wrong this time? Is it your recycling device? I'm not your mechanic, y'know? I have my own tasks to work on!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's a recycling device?

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: It's a... well, special equipment of the desert expedition team. Think of it as a water purification device that can convert the water excreted by the human body into drinking water.

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: In this way, we can not only save the time looking for toilets everywhere, but also produce enough drinking water for ourselves, which is rather important in the desert, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you're saying... Ewwww!

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: That's enough. Is this boot yours?

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: I don't think so. It doesn't smell like mine.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Smell?

response.speaker: Ilyusha
response.text: I never wash my feet.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Ugh, stay away from me.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: Alright. It's not ours. Anything else?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No. Let's fight.

response.speaker: Yevgraf
response.text: But thanks anyway. After I bury you, I'll ask whose boot it is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's how it is... They're taking Jeht to the canyon!
Stop... Please stop hitting me! I'll give you whatever you want!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... These are all daily supplies for camping. Looks like they were taken from a nearby tribe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon sees no other clue... {NICKNAME}, let's ask this guy!
Wait, what do you want to know? I'm not telling you anything. I don't know anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Name. Tell us your name.
What?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's Paimon, and I'm your worst nightmare. What about you?
What?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you understand me? Yes or no?
Y—Yes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Very well. Your name. Tell me.

dialogues.speaker: Orest
dialogues.text: O—Orest. Private Orest Snezhevich.

dialogues.speaker: Orest
dialogues.text: I—I really don't know anything... I just joined the desert expedition team, and I haven't even familiarized myself with the organization of our forces. You literally can't get anything out of me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We haven't asked you anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jeht. Does this name ring any bells?

dialogues.speaker: Orest
dialogues.text: N—No...

choices.text: Liar. Tell me everything you know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{M#He}{F#She} means that if you tell us, we'll let you go!

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Wait, wait! I'll talk! I'll tell you everything I know, but that's all I know!

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: That girl named Jeht... She... she's a monster.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: They were going to bring her back in a cage... But she woke up and tore the cage apart, and then, the guy standing closest to her... Oh my, poor Jophery...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened...?

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: He... he, uh... changed. He became like... like festive confetti...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: You know, uh... Sometimes bits of confetti would fly into your mouth and you'd just try to spit them out, right? But, but...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Well, when we realized something was wrong, we realized... that those weren't confetti, it was Jophery...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Stop, stop! Paimon's feeling sick...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: What happened later... I wasn't sure. It was all messed up...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Thanks to our medic, Podporuchik Muldoon, who acted fast and saved us all.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: "Shoot her! Shoot her!" "Pull out your guns!" He yelled like that. And we fired at her with all the Electro bullets we had that were supposed to paralyze our prey.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? With guns and bullets!? She could die!

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Someone already died! One of our people!

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: *sigh* Anyway, long story short, she's alive and asleep. She fell into a deep slumber this time.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: But... the thought of her waking up and going into a rage again, I can't help but... *cough*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is Jeht... really that scary?

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: She... she's not a girl... She's a monster! A real monster!

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: You... you know, I came to the desert... to do this business. I can earn a lot of Mora, a lot of tax-free Mora every day... *cough* I get to support my family...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: I mean... I can afford to send my sister to school, an esteemed one... so that she won't be sent to the House of the Hearth like me...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Well... I'm not saying that the House of the Hearth is terrible or anything, but I want her to have a brighter future, y'know... She's an orphan too, just like me...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: She wanted to learn the violin or something... I don't really get that rich people stuff...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Anyway, I was ignorant and naive back then... All I knew was that when I grew up and joined the Fatui, I would be able to make her wish come true...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Sorry, my apologies... I must've talked too much... *cough* I wasn't trying to win your sympathy or anything, I just wanted to say...

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: ...that I did not join the Fatui just to suffer like this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Wow... Is Jeht so scary when she gets angry...?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tell me where she is and you can go home.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Th—Thanks... I'll mark the location on your map.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: See this camp? It's the transfer station where we transported her. Even if she's not there, you should be able to find the next location.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: If possible, when you arrive at this camp, can you warn my colleagues and officers for me?

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Uh, just let them get rid of that nightmare as soon as possible... Our mission has already failed, and there can be no results.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about you? Aren't you going back?

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: No... As long as they insist on capturing her alive, I dare not to go back.

choices.text: We are better at beating people than passing on messages.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: Thanks... If that's all, I'll be leaving now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can go now! Don't go back to the camp or we will beat you again!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Orest limped away, and his lonely figure quickly faded into the desert...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, we should leave as well! The next camp isn't too far away.

choices.text: I'll make sure everyone is well-persuaded.

response.speaker: Orest
response.text: N—No! You don't get it! H—How could you possibly get it!?

choices.text: Or you can be like your colleagues.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's nothing about Jeht... Let's keep looking and see if there're any other files at the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's another document mentioned here. Why don't we search that one, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's how it is... They're taking Jeht to the canyon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's another document mentioned here. Why don't we search that one, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... It seems that someone in the tribe is working with the Fatui, that's why Jeht... Ugh! Who could it be?

choices.text: Maybe it's the same person who framed Jeht for her rebellion...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then we'd better find Jeht first and fast. She's still in great danger, and now, the Tanit tribe is no longer a safe place either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's hurry!

choices.text: We must find Jeht first and fast.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're right. After all, she's still in great danger. We must find her soon and figure out what's going on!

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: You're back. Is there any news about Jeht?

choices.text: I need a bit more time.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Of course... Please, make sure you find her.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: I still cannot fathom why she'd cooperate with those dangerous northerners... Maybe it's those northerners who kidnapped her.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: In any case, she would need to either confess to the Tanit or publicly prove her innocence. It's the tribe's rules, and there's nothing I can do about it.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: As I said before, the Tanit used to have established a trade relationship with them. But soon after, these northerners started planting spies and training moles among us...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Only by then did I realize that the people who sent them to the desert are probably not well-intentioned...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Hence, we expelled those northerners from tribal territory, and only allowed them to settle on the outskirts of the desert.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Who knew they harbored such... lofty ambitions, and still tried to infiltrate our tribe regardless. Perhaps they heard about the Eternal Oasis...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: May quicksand and poisonous winds stay away from you, esteemed Master of the Jinni!

dialogues.speaker: Babel
dialogues.text: Greetings, esteemed Master of the Jinni. Have you got any news?

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: That's good... I hope you find her soon. I'm also very... very concerned about her.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Ugh... You have no idea how much I want to question those northerners in person, but if I rushed it, it would definitely alarm them, which would be even more detrimental to Jeht's safety.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Therefore, esteemed Master of the Jinni, on tribe's future rests on your shoulders.

choices.text: She's been kidnapped by the Fatui.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Is that so... In other words, she didn't betray the tribe? No... We still can't rule that possibility out...

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: I see... Can you confirm her location? I will send people to rescue her immediately.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I... I don't know.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: In this case, even if we sent out a rescue team, it would only alert those northerners... It isn't to her advantage.

response.speaker: Babel
response.text: Although making such a decision makes my heart ache much, I refuse to startle our enemy. I will continue to wait for your words.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Babel really cares for Jeht...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The location Babel marked... This should be the place! Let's go and find out if Jeht is here!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher No. 2
dialogues.text: Password? Wait... We're under attack!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... The sandstorm is almost blinding Paimon! Huh? Is there someone in the sandstorm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... The sandstorm is almost blinding Paimon! Huh? Is there someone in the sandstorm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's keep going! There should be more of them ahead!
